messages:
nitya: Heads up — we're seeing a surge of ptls handshake_failures and 503s in ap-south after the infra-iam push at 01:40 UTC. Is that the RBAC change?

ash: Yup, I shipped infra-iam:allow-rotator-to-write-certs (revoke-old-roles) around 01:39 to tidy up perms. Didn't expect it to touch kms:Decrypt bindings for rotator-sa.

ravi: Control-plane logs show repeated unwrap errors during certificate serve: `keystore: unwrap failed: AccessDeniedException: Caller lacks kms:Decrypt on key/rotator-key` between 01:41:10-01:42:05.

maria: If the control-plane can't unwrap private keys we may be serving cert chains without matching private keys which will cause TLS to abort. Can you grep proxy logs for TLS Alert 40?

ravi: found it: `proxy-eu-ap-south-03: TLS alert 40 (handshake_failure) when sending CertificateVerify` and earlier `keystore: served cert chain but no private key available for subject=svc-edge`.

nitya: I ran a quick check against an affected proxy:
```
$ openssl s_client -connect proxy-ap-south-03:443 -servername svc-edge -alpn ptls/1 -showcerts
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=svc-edge
 1 s:/CN=intermediate-2026-03
---
SSL handshake has read 0 bytes and written 0 bytes
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
```

ash: deploy-bot — any infra runs that touched IAM recently?

deploy-bot: terraform apply infra/iam @ 2026-03-16T01:39:12Z: changed resource `google_service_account_iam_binding.rotator-sa` replaced. No other deploys in that window.

maria: Remediation plan: 1) rollback the IAM binding immediately to restore kms:Decrypt for rotator-sa, 2) restart affected control-plane pods to pick up restored perms, 3) add a preflight that validates KMS unwrap success for new IAM changes, 4) alerting: create rule for keystore unwrap AccessDenied spike >0.1% in 5m.

ravi: I'm on the rollback now. Also recommend adding an emergency fallback: if unwrap fails, control-plane should refuse to rotate and continue serving existing keystore rather than serving unpaired cert chains.

nitya: Agreed. For postmortem include: exact IAM diff, timestamps of unwrap failures, list of affected regions/services, customer impact (503 count), and compliance note (were any keys accessed unexpectedly?).

maria: I'll add RBAC change playbook steps: require an unwrap smoke test and a 10m canary window for IAM changes that touch rotator or keystore roles.

ash: rolled back at 01:45 UTC. Ravi, can you confirm unwraps succeed after restart?

ravi: Restarted control-plane replicas at 01:47. Logs: `keystore: unwrap OK for key/rotator-key, served cert with private key` and proxy telemetry shows handshake_success metric back to baseline by 01:50.

nitya: Closing P1. Follow-ups: audit KMS policy changes, add preflight smoke, and update change approval checklist to include KMS-sensitive roles. :white_check_mark:
